name: Summon Undead

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry.

targets.description: an unoccupied space you can see within range

upcast.text: Use the slot level as the spell's level in the Undead Spirit stat block.

summary: Summon an Undead Spirit (Ghostly, Putrid or Skeletal) that fights beside you for up to 1 hour.
text: You call forth an Undead spirit, which appears in an unoccupied space you can see within 90 feet and uses the Undead Spirit stat block below. When you cast the spell, choose its form: Ghostly, Putrid or Skeletal. The form decides which traits and attacks it has. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. It counts as an ally of you and your allies. In combat it shares your Initiative count but takes its turn right after yours. It follows your verbal commands (no action required by you); if you give none, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger. Undead Spirit (Medium Undead): AC 11 + the spell's level; Hit Points 30 (Ghostly and Putrid) or 20 (Skeletal) + 10 for each spell level above 3; Speed 30 ft., and Fly 40 ft. with hover (Ghostly only); Str 12, Dex 16, Con 15, Int 4, Wis 10, Cha 9; Immunity to Necrotic and Poison damage and to the Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed and Poisoned conditions; Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10; understands the languages you know; uses your Proficiency Bonus. Festering Aura (Putrid only): any creature other than you that starts its turn within a 5-foot Emanation of the spirit makes a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. Incorporeal Passage (Ghostly only): it can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain; if it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 Force damage for every 5 feet it moves. Multiattack: it makes a number of attacks equal to half the spell's level (round down). Deathly Touch (Ghostly only): melee attack roll using your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft.; on a hit, 1d8 + 3 + the spell's level Necrotic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Grave Bolt (Skeletal only): ranged attack roll using your spell attack modifier, range 150 ft.; on a hit, 2d4 + 3 + the spell's level Necrotic damage. Rotting Claw (Putrid only): melee attack roll using your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft.; on a hit, 1d6 + 3 + the spell's level Slashing damage, and a target that has the Poisoned condition also has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: use the slot's level as the spell's level in the stat block.
